text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle 
Series! And even after that, I stood 
entirely alone—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let our era be taken away!" they 
fought. Dreaming of the day their 
comrades-in-arms would return.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However, the comrades who finally returned 
no longer possessed the strength to fight 
in the great war—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I fought on alone! Slashing, slashing, and 
slashing away, battling like a raging 
lion, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—All worldly things are impermanent. No 
castle stands unfallen forever.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The branches of the Clan of Silence 
continue to spread wider and wider, and 
what's more—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
With the rise of a new faction, the Great 
King's clique, 'we' were steadily driven 
into a corner.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, though a few fought back, before 
long our names—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It ended up lingering only in a forgotten 
corner of the era.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I found a new purpose in life, 
and—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! Forward march, to the 
'Sacred Flag Scramble'!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The racetrack is not the only battlefield 
for an Umamusume! I shall show them what 
I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the traditional Soma Nomaoi festival, 
No Reason dashes forward, raising total 
havoc on his own...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Go-o-o-o!! Looking great, No Reason!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Show us an upset here, too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! My true power starts right 
heeeeere!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Behold, my all-out sprint!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from Another Hometown
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, hurry! Get there before No 
Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh...! ...Or so you thought—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm just the decoy!! The real target is 
the flag on the opposite side!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Onward, my comrades! Seize the flag--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason's command as a general was 
brilliant. And then...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Victory, oh victory! Dance, dance, 
daaance~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Outstanding in both stature and character. 
Respected by all and beloved by everyone, 
she was truly the 'face' of the community.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good work to thee as well.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout this, havin' ya tag along 
outside of races and all.
choice_data_list: No, I'm having a great time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason often participates not just in 
races, but in traditional events like this 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, lately, she's been so passionate about 
it that it might even be her main focus 
now.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Tell me, Trainer. Is the path I am 
currently walking..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"It may not be the orthodox path. Yet, it 
is surprisingly not half bad."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. The overthrow of the giants that I 
dreamt of did not come to pass. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot leave behind my running for 
posterity, then I shall leave behind 
culture! Yes, I never go down without 
getting something out of it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Besides, who knows... perhaps you'll find 
an unexpected way to leave your running 
behind, eh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Same Hometown
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, No Reason-san! Thank you so much 
for today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Same Hometown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I didn't draw any unwanted 
attention and was able to pull off a great 
performance!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! Supporting our efforts from the 
shadows. That, too, is a general's duty!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Despite how we look, it seems we also have 
a knack for working behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as No Reason puffed out her chest 
with pride...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... No Reason-san. I have a favor to 
ask...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho?! Could thou be... Still-dono?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Still in Love. What could she possibly be 
doing here away from the racetrack?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"One of my kin has shown great interest in 
this Soma Nomaoi..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you... would you 
consider letting this girl join your 
group?

text_block_list.name: Still's Retinue
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you for having me! I've been so 
interested in this event!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye! I see, I see, then I shall accept! 
You may rest easy knowing you are in 
capable hands. For you see—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite accustomed to handling the 
silent lineage, you see. That dormant 
power of yours—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I shall draw out every last drop of your 
potential! Nyahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason lets out a hearty laugh. His 
laughter is loud... and a little dry.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how distant dreams can be... Yet, 
Trainer, it is well. This is as it should 
be.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, there is no inherent 
reason for our lives! It's simply—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A single race! This very moment today! As 
long as it's so passionate that it lasts a 
lifetime, that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Dost thou not think so, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Ah, being able to spend time with you... I 
have no regrets...

Yeah, being able to spend time with you... 
I have no regrets...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha! Indeed, indeed!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Likewise—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who will seize the realm? Through 
repeating fierce battles, the era of the 
Umamusume moves forward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And usually, the one who unifies the realm 
is the colossal general commanding the 
greatest forces. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――An unexpected dark horse. It is the 
races where such a contender pulls off a 
massive upset that remain vivid in our 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason. Even if the world cannot be 
changed—the remnants of the dream will 
never fade.
